claim: The Tweez 300 GUI answers -14 (busy) to commands sent back to back on one socket: with no gap 16 of 24 readiness probes came back busy, and 0 of 24 at every gap tried from 2 ms up -- but a trap-create command still came back busy at a 10 ms gap, so the settling time depends on the command.

numbers.name: smallest_gap_with_no_busy_probe
numbers.note: gaps tried: 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 ms; 0 of 24 busy at each. A floor for the probe command only.

validity_conditions: Measured in the prior project on the microscope PC on 2026-08-27. -14 is an explicit rejection -- the GUI answered and did not run the command -- which is what makes re-sending on -14 safe, and a missing reply is the case that must never be re-sent, since relative commands would move a trap twice. Ruled TRANSFER for the measurement; the prior driver's chosen gap, retry count, backoff and timeout were not transferred (src_prior_tweezers_driver_20260827). The 2026-09-24 session used those choices and saw no busy answer in 75 commands, which neither confirms nor bounds anything here.
